author: Scott Cousins
title: East Alton man indicted in July 5 Downtown Alton shooting - NewsBreak
text: EDWARDSVILLE — An East Alton man was indicted last week in a July 5 shooting in Downtown Alton. The incident gained attention on social media. Andre L. Darden, 45, of East Alton, was indicted Aug. 7 for aggravated battery with a firearm, a Class X felony; felon in possession of a weapon, a Class 3 felony; and reckless discharge of a firearm, a Class 4 felony. He was originally charged on July 22. The charges were suppressed but made public by the Alton Police Department after Darden was taken into custody with the help of the U.S. Marshals Service. According to court documents, on July 5, Darden shot another man in the hand; was a felon in possession of a 9mm handgun; and shot the gun in a “reckless manner” at the intersection of State and Wall streets. It was noted he has a prior felony conviction for criminal trespass to an occupied residence out of Madison County in 2013, making him ineligible to possess weapons. Additional court documents stated that police responded to reports of shots fired at Wall and State streets. Video showed an altercation, and Darden was identified as the initial aggressor. He is observed taking off his shirt and pushing another man outside the bar, and a fight breaks out. Darden then displayed a gun and fired it, chasing the victim through the crowd. This individual has only been charged and remains innocent until proven guilty in a court of law. All charges may not be reported.
